assessments.summary: Measles cases in the US are peaking with a 100% increase from the previous year's same period, driven by a recent loss of U.S. Measles Elimination Status.
Polio cases are peaking with a 93% increase from the previous year's same period, linked to a cluster of circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 1 cases in Syria.
Dengue cases in the US are peaking with an 853% increase from the previous year's same period, accompanied by rising news coverage.
Influenza cases are peaking with a 22% increase in global test positivity and 55% rise in US hospitalizations compared to the previous month.
Mpox cases in the US are peaking with an 87% increase from the previous year's same period, and news coverage is rising.
Pertussis cases in the US are rising with a 55% increase from the previous year's same period, and news coverage is increasing.
West Nile virus cases in the US are rising with a 1388% increase from the previous year's same period, indicating a significant seasonal surge.
Covid-19 hospital admissions in the US are at baseline with a 13% increase from the previous month, and Wikipedia readership is low.
RSV activity is at baseline with a 58/100 score, showing a slight increase in test positivity and hospitalizations compared to the previous month.
Norovirus activity is at baseline with a 58/100 score, indicated by increased news coverage and Wikipedia readership compared to the past year.
Hepatitis A activity is at baseline with a 53/100 score, showing a 10% increase in US weekly cases compared to the previous 8 months.
